LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东賢，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Dōngxián, méi xiǎngdào cái liǎng nián méi jiàn, nǐ yǐjīng shì ge dà míngxīng le. Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō, wǒ hái yào jìxù nǔlì.
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yǐjīng hěn nǔlì le. Érqiě, nǐ de zhōngwén jìnbù de zhème kuài, shì zěnme zuò dào de?
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jùběn lǐ yào shuō de bùfèn, dōu qǐng lǎoshī lù le yīn, yì yǒu kòng jiù búduàn de tīng, búduàn de liànxí. Zhèyàngzi cái xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计画？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhēn shì ge hǎo bànfǎ, nánguài nǐ jìnbù de zhème kuài. Duì le, nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme jìhuà?
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng dǎoyǎn, nǎozi lǐ měitiān dōu xiǎng zhe zhè jiàn shì. Yǒushí lián zuòmèng dōu mèng dào zìjǐ pāi diànyǐng de yàngzi, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián kāishǐ xué pāi diànyǐng.
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn? Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, érqiě shénme juésè dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxī a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Director? You look so handsome, are tall enough, and act well in every role; how regrettable it would be if you didn't become an actor! Besides, audiences highly recognize your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn háishì kěyǐ yǎnxì de. Qíshí, yào dāng hǎo dǎoyǎn, búdàn děi dǒng zěnme pāi diànyǐng, yě yào jiāo yǎnyuán yǎnxì, tiǎozhàn gèng dà.
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō bùshǎo dǎoyǎn wèile bǎ diànyǐng pāi hǎo, lián jiā dōu hěn shǎo huíqù, yǒude hái yīnwèi zhèyàng shēngbìng le. Búguò, wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào nǐ yǒu shílì, jiù búpà tiǎozhàn le.
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīntiān néng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn liáoliao zhēn hǎo.
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: Nà nǐ yǐhòu bié zài gēn wǒ shuō, yīnwèi yào yǎn zǒngtǒng, shíyóu gōngsī dà lǎobǎn shénme de, méi shíjiān gēn péngyou jù yí jù. Bùguǎn duō máng, nǐ yě yào liú diǎnr shíjiān gěi péngyou a!
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: Èn! Duì le, yě liáoliao nǐ zìjǐ ba. Nǐ xué de shì fǎlǜ, yǐhòu yào dāng lǜshī ba?
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ xué fǎlǜ shì yīnwèi bàba de yāoqiú. Tā xīwàng wǒ xiān dāng lǜshī, jiānglái yǒu jīhuì dāng shàng shìzhǎng jiù gèng hǎo le.
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: Suǒyǐ dāng shìzhǎng shì nǐ de mèngxiǎng ma?
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: Ài, shéi xiǎng dāng shìzhǎng a? Búguò, cóngxiǎo wǒ bàmā shénme shì dōu tì wǒ ānpái hǎo le, suīrán bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě zhǐ néng rěnnài.
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒmen dōu bú shì xiǎoháizi le, zìjǐ de wèilái yīnggāi zìjǐ juédìng ba.
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Dànshì wǒ bàmā de xiǎngfǎ tài bǎoshǒu le, yìshí hěn nán gǎibiàn tāmen.
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: Xīwàng yǒu yì tiān, nǐ yě néng wèile zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng nǔlì.
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: Èn, wǒmen yìqǐ jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursues His Dream

text.traditional: 現在的電影市場比以前大多了，當導演的機會也變多了，還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。其實不管在哪一個年代，要拍一部好電影，都是很大的學問。現在科技進步、資源豐富，觀眾對好電影的要求越來越高，拍戲和演戲的工作就變得更不簡單了。
text.simplified: 现在的电影市场比以前大多了，当导演的机会也变多了，还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。其实不管在哪一个年代，要拍一部好电影，都是很大的学问。现在科技进步、资源丰富，观众对好电影的要求越来越高，拍戏和演戏的工作就变得更不简单了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànyǐng shìchǎng bǐ yǐqián dà duō le, dāng dǎoyǎn de jīhuì yě biàn duō le, hái yǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Qíshí bùguǎn zài nǎ yí ge niándài, yào pāi yí bù hǎo diànyǐng, dōu shì hěn dà de xuéwèn. Xiànzài kējì jìnbù, zīyuán fēngfù, guānzhòng duì hǎo diànyǐng de yāoqiú yuè lái yuè gāo, pāixì hàn yǎnxì de gōngzuò jiù biàn de gèng bù jiǎndān le.
text.english: Today's film market is much larger than before, and opportunities to become a director have also increased; there are also some directors who became very famous because they made great movies. Actually, no matter in which era, making a good movie requires great learning. Nowadays, with technological progress and abundant resources, audiences have higher and higher demands for good movies, so the work of filmmaking and acting has become even less simple.

text.traditional: 東賢從小的夢想就是當一名導演，但是有導演夢的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改變主意。不過，性格開朗的東賢向他們保證，為了追求夢想，他一定會努力的。他跟父母說，要先到臺灣學習中文，還要去上表演課程，等中文學得不錯後，再學習更專業的導演技巧。而且他已經成年了，知道怎麼照顧自己，吃點苦也沒關係。爸媽聽了東賢的說明後，覺得他很勇敢、很認真，最後就答應了。
text.simplified: 东贤从小的梦想就是当一名导演，但是有导演梦的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改变主意。不过，性格开朗的东贤向他们保证，为了追求梦想，他一定会努力的。他跟父母说，要先到台湾学习中文，还要去上表演课程，等中文学得不错后，再学习更专业的导演技巧。而且他已经成年了，知道怎么照顾自己，吃点苦也没关系。爸妈听了东贤的说明后，觉得他很勇敢、很认真，最后就答应了。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng jiù shì dāng yì míng dǎoyǎn, dànshì yǒu dǎoyǎnmèng de rén hěn duō, néng chénggōng de rén hěn shǎo, suǒyǐ fùmǔ xīwàng tā néng gǎibiàn zhǔyì. Búguò, xìnggé kāilǎng de Dōngxián xiàng tāmen bǎozhèng, wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, tā yídìng huì nǔlì de. Tā gēn fùmǔ shuō, yào xiān dào Táiwān xuéxí zhōngwén, hái yào qù shàng biǎoyǎn kèchéng, děng zhōngwén xué de búcuò hòu, zài xuéxí gèng zhuānyè de dǎoyǎn jìqiǎo. Érqiě tā yǐjīng chéngnián le, zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, chī diǎn kǔ yě méi guānxi. Bàmā tīng le Dōngxián de shuōmíng hòu, juéde tā hěn yǒnggǎn, hěn rènzhēn, zuìhòu jiù dāying le.
text.english: Dongxian's dream since childhood was to become a director, but there are many people with directing dreams and very few who succeed, so his parents hoped he would change his mind. However, cheerful Dongxian promised them that he would work hard to pursue his dream. He told his parents that he would first go to Taiwan to learn Chinese, attend acting courses, and after learning Chinese well, learn more professional directing skills. Moreover, he was already an adult, knew how to take care of himself, and enduring a bit of hardship didn't matter. After listening to Dongxian's explanation, his parents felt he was very brave and earnest, and finally agreed.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣以後，東賢很快就適應了新的生活，也找到了一份模特兒的工作。這樣不但有錢付生活費，還能讓表演經驗更豐富。這種為了夢想，每天很早出門、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。因為對他來說，夢想就像一張美麗的圖，一開始只是一張白紙，想追求夢想的人就得自己設計、配上顏色，最後才能完成一張好圖。他相信只要自己肯努力，最後一定能夢想成真的。
text.simplified: 到了台湾以后，东贤很快就适应了新的生活，也找到了一份模特儿的工作。这样不但有钱付生活费，还能让表演经验更丰富。这种为了梦想，每天很早出门、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。因为对他来说，梦想就像一张美丽的一张白纸，想追求梦想的人就得自己设计、配上颜色，最后才能完成一张好图。他相信只要自己肯努力，最后一定能梦想成真的。
text.pinyin: Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, Dōngxián hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le xīn de shēnghuó, yě zhǎodào le yí fèn mótèr de gōngzuò. Zhèyàng búdàn yǒu qián fù shēnghuófèi, hái néng ràng biǎoyǎn jīngyàn gèng fēngfù. Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng, měitiān hěn zǎo chūmén, hěn wǎn huíjiā de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú. Yīnwèi duì tā lái shuō, mèngxiǎng jiù xiàng yì zhāng měilì de tú, yì kāishǐ zhǐ shì yì zhāng báizhǐ, xiǎng zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de rén jiù děi zìjǐ shèjì, pèi shàng yánsè, zuìhòu cái néng wánchéng yì zhāng hǎo tú. Tā xiāngxìn zhǐyào zìjǐ kěn nǔlì, zuìhòu yídìng néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de.
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian quickly adapted to his new life and also found a job as a model. This not only provided money to pay living expenses, but also enriched his acting experience. For this kind of life of leaving early and returning late every day for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy and satisfied. Because to him, a dream is like a beautiful picture: in the beginning it is only a blank sheet of paper, and a person who wants to pursue a dream must design it himself and add colors, and only then can complete a good picture. He believes that as long as he is willing to work hard, his dream will surely come true in the end.

LESSON_ONE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Predicate

patternRows.english: You could say that I am a fan of yours.
You could say that he is already an adult.
You could say this is my second home.

items.question: Can 可以說是 mean physical ability to speak?
items.answer: No. 可以說是 means 'practically / you could say'; use 可以說 without 是 for ability or permission to speak.

right.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shuō yí jù zhōngwén.
right.english: I can speak a sentence of Chinese.

items.question: Does 可以說是 replace normal 是 in direct facts?
items.answer: Use 可以說是 to soften a description or summarize; use ordinary 是 for direct factual identities.

right.english: He really is my older brother.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí ō, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I'm a fan of yours, so quickly sign an autograph for me!

words.meaning: you could say; can be said to be

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù mǎn shíbā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yí ge dàrén le.
text.english: He will turn eighteen next month; you could say he is already an adult.

words.meaning: you could say; can be said to be

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhèlǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì èr ge jiā.
text.english: I have lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; you could say this is my second home.

words.meaning: you could say; can be said to be

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 可以說是 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.hint: Use the phrase meaning "you could say that".

questions.correctFeedback: 可以說是 explains and summarizes the situation before the noun phrase 個中國通了。
questions.repairFeedback: Use 可以說是 before the noun predicate; 可以說 without 是 indicates ability to speak.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express feelings that exceed expectations using 多麼…啊.
grammarPages.explanation: This construction indicates an exclamation when something exceeds one's expectations. In casual speech, 麼 can be dropped (多…啊).

patternRows.english: How regrettable it is not to be an actor!
How comfortable it is to eat shaved ice at home!

items.question: Can 多麼 ask for quantity or cost?
items.answer: No. 多麼 is exclusively an exclamation of degree ('how...!'); use 多少 to ask for prices or quantities.

items.question: Does 多麼 modify a noun directly?
items.answer: 多麼 modifies adjectives/stative verbs, not bare nouns; say 多麼好 instead of 多麼人.

right.pinyin: Tā shì duóme hǎo de rén a!
right.english: What a wonderful person he is!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a!
text.english: You grew up looking so good; what a pity not to be an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dàdà de, ěrduo chángcháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog has big eyes and long ears; how cute it is!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒ bīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's scorching outside; eating mango ice while watching TV at home, how comfortable it is!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 多麼…啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.correctFeedback: Use 多麼 in the exclamatory pattern 多麼 + Adjective + 啊！
questions.repairFeedback: In an exclamation ending in 啊, use 多麼 rather than plain 很.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the preceding sentence with an additional reason.

patternRows.english: It's a pity not to be an actor; besides, the audience really appreciates you.
I have to hand in a report recently; besides, final exams are coming up soon.
Clubs let you make friends; besides, you can also learn more about yourself.

items.question: Can 再說 alone mean 'say it again'?
items.answer: As a conjunction adding reasons, 再說 introduces a clause; to ask someone to repeat, say 請再說一次.

right.pinyin: Qǐng zài shuō yí cì, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
right.english: Please say it once again, I didn't understand.

items.question: Where does conjunction 再說 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 再說 sits at the beginning of the reinforcing clause, never at the very end.

right.traditional: 我不想去，再說我也沒有錢。
right.simplified: 我不想去，再说我也没有钱。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, zàishuō wǒ yě méiyǒu qián.
right.english: I don't want to go; besides, I have no money.

text.traditional: 不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: What a pity not to be an actor! Besides, the audience really appreciates your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qīmòkǎo le, xià xīngqī de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have to hand in two reports recently; besides, final exams are coming soon, so I won't go on next week's trip.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己。
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己。
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāodào bù shǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ.
text.english: Joining clubs lets you make many friends; besides, it helps us understand ourselves better.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 再說 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 我也剛換好衣服，別出門了吧。
segments.simplified: 我也刚换好衣服，别出门了吧。

questions.correctFeedback: 再說 introduces an additional reinforcing reason.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 再說 to add another reason for not going out.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东賢，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计画？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Director? You grew up looking so handsome, you are tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

LESSON_ONE_PART_ONE.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two clauses showing causal result or contrast using 而.
grammarPages.explanation: 而 connects two clauses, often indicating a transition, contrast, or cause-and-effect relationship in formal writing.

patternRows.english: The parents worried, and therefore opposed this decision.
Because he couldn't adapt to the city, he moved to the countryside.
Although pursuing dreams is hard, he never gives up.

items.question: Can 而 connect two nouns like 和?
items.answer: No. 而 connects two clauses or verb phrases; use 和 or 跟 to connect nouns.

right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
right.english: I want to buy apples and bananas.

items.question: Where is 而 placed between two clauses?
items.answer: 而 stands before the second verb or predicate clause, not before the subject.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很聰明，而大家都喜歡他。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很聪明，而大家都喜欢他。

right.english: He is smart and also kind.

text.traditional: 東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定。
text.simplified: 东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián de fùmǔ yīnwèi dānxīn tā de wèilái ér fǎnduì zhège juédìng.
text.english: Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bù shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bāndào le xiāngxià, guò zhe jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he couldn't adapt to stressful city life, he moved to the countryside to live a simple life.

text.traditional: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重視內心的平靜與快樂。
text.simplified: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重视内心的平静与快乐。
text.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén zhuīqiú mínglì, ér yǒuxiē rén gèng zhòngshì nèixīn de píngjìng yǔ kuàilè.
text.english: Some people pursue fame and fortune, while others value inner peace and happiness more.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 他因為不適應都市的生活，
segments.simplified: 他因为不适应都市的生活，

questions.correctFeedback: 因為…而… connects the cause directly to the subsequent action in one sentence.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 而 to link the cause with the verb phrase 搬到了鄉下.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express producing a new creation or result through an action using V出.
grammarPages.explanation: When 出 follows a verb here, it indicates that a new item or creative result is produced through the action (e.g. 寫出, 畫出, 做不出).

patternRows.english: As long as you work hard, you can paint out a wonderful life.
He spent three years writing out a bestselling novel.
I studied for a long time, but still cannot turn out a satisfying cake.

items.question: Does V出 mean physical movement out of a place?
items.answer: V出 here emphasizes creating or bringing an idea into reality (想出, 寫出); physical emergence uses 走出來.

right.pinyin: Tā cóng fángjiān zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: He walked out from the room.

items.question: Can any verb take 出 to mean production?
items.answer: Only verbs of creation or cognition take productive 出 (想出, 做出, 畫出, 寫出).

right.pinyin: Tā huà chū le yì zhāng huà.

text.traditional: 只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。
text.simplified: 只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyào búduàn nǔlì, jiù yídìng néng huà chū jīngcǎi de rénshēng.
text.english: As long as you keep working hard, you can definitely paint out a wonderful life.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐ'ài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote out a novel that everyone loves.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bù chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I learned cake baking for a long time, but still cannot turn out a cake that satisfies myself.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

segments.traditional: 他花了一年的時間，終於寫
segments.simplified: 他花了一年的时间，终于写

segments.hint: Result complement for creating a new work.

questions.correctFeedback: 寫出 indicates bringing a new creative work into existence.
questions.repairFeedback: Use the result complement 出 for creating and producing a new work.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State that an outcome or decision remains unchanged regardless of a hypothetical condition.
grammarPages.explanation: 就算 is a conjunction followed by a hypothetical condition, expressing that the original fact, attitude, or decision will not be changed by that condition.
grammarPages.pattern: 就算 + Condition (，) + 也 + Result / Action

patternRows.english: Even if it rains, I still must go to school.

subject.traditional: 就算一天工作十二個小時
subject.simplified: 就算一天工作十二个小时
subject.pinyin: jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí

columns.traditional: 就算一天工作十二個小時
columns.simplified: 就算一天工作十二个小时
columns.pinyin: jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí

patternRows.english: Even if she works 12 hours a day, it is no problem.

subject.pinyin: jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē
subject.meaning: even if not eating or drinking for 20 years

columns.pinyin: jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē
columns.meaning: even if not eating or drinking for 20 years

patternRows.english: Even if one does not eat or drink for twenty years, one still cannot afford to buy it.

examples.speaker: 旁白
examples.traditional: 這種為了夢想的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心。
examples.simplified: 这种为了梦想的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: For this kind of life for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy.

text.traditional: 這種為了夢想的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心。
text.simplified: 这种为了梦想的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn.
text.english: For this kind of life for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy.

examples.speaker: 方小姐
examples.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
examples.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
examples.english: Miss Fang wants to save more money; even if she works twelve hours a day, it is no problem.

text.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
text.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
text.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Miss Fang wants to save more money; even if she works twelve hours a day, it is no problem.

examples.speaker: 旁白
examples.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
examples.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: I feel house prices in that area are too high; even if one does not eat or drink for twenty years, one still cannot afford it.

text.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
text.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: I feel house prices in that area are too high; even if one does not eat or drink for twenty years, one still cannot afford it.

items.question: Can 就算 and 雖然 be used interchangeably?
items.answer: No. 雖然 introduces an established fact, while 就算 introduces a hypothetical condition (even if).
items.wrongTraditional: 雖然明天考試很難，我也要去唱歌。
items.wrongSimplified: 虽然明天考试很难，我也要去唱歌。

right.traditional: 就算明天考試很難，我也要去唱歌。
right.simplified: 就算明天考试很难，我也要去唱歌。
right.pinyin: Jiùsuàn míngtiān kǎoshì hěn nán, wǒ yě yào qù chànggē.
right.english: Even if tomorrow's test is very difficult, I still want to go singing.

items.question: Can 就算 be paired with 但是 instead of 也?
items.answer: No. 就算 must pair with 也 (or 還) in the main clause, not 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 就算下大雨，但是我一定要去跑步。
items.wrongSimplified: 就算下大雨，但是我一定要去跑步。

right.traditional: 就算下大雨，我也要去跑步。
right.simplified: 就算下大雨，我也要去跑步。
right.pinyin: Jiùsuàn xià dàyǔ, wǒ yě yào qù pǎobù.
right.english: Even if it pours with rain, I still want to go running.

questions.repairFeedback: Use 就算 to emphasize that the hypothetical situation will not change the decision.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

text.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
text.simplified: 东賢从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位着名的导演。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

text.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
text.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东賢高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

text.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
text.simplified: 起初，东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

text.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
text.simplified: 但东賢拿出自己的计画书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
text.simplified: 到了台湾后，东賢一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

text.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
text.simplified: 东賢说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
text.pinyin: pīnyīn
text.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'
